raw:
Agent Name: FileSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The FileSurfer agent failed to extract the actual word count data from the spreadsheet. Instead of providing the specific word counts for each book as requested by the Orchestrator's plan, it only extracted the reading dates and then instructed the team to "Estimate the number of words per book using average words per page or search online." This premature decision to rely on external estimation rather than using the available data in the spreadsheet (which likely contained the word counts) led to a cascade of unnecessary web searches and reliance on potentially inaccurate estimated values, ultimately resulting in an incorrect calculation of the slowest reading speed.
